info.name: Phos
info.summary: Sync server and web UI for the Phos Bible study app
info.description:
Server side of the Phos Bible study app. Keeps bookmarks, notes, study pads, reading plans, study projects, sermons, presentations and SWORD modules in sync between Phos desktop, Phos mobile and the browser, with offline-safe merging, conflicts kept instead of dropped, and per-device "local only" data. Collections can be shared with users, groups and teams, or through read-only links.
The web UI reads the synced SWORD modules directly in PHP: Bible with parallel texts, Strong's numbers, footnotes and cross-references, commentaries, dictionaries and books, search with a query builder, facts pages, gospel synopsis, word study, reading plan, sermons, presentations with presenter view and phone remote, ePub and PDF.
info.author: Jens
